entry.title: New: dsh-firstrun
entry.summary: First-run health check for DeepSeek Harness: verifies Node/pnpm/dsh toolchain, home, profile, API key (names only, never values), workspace writability and npm registry, then prints actionable next steps — CLI plus an agent-callable quickstart tool, dsh-firstrun/v1 reports, zero runtime deps. Exact install spec: github:zoahdev/dsh-firstrun. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
